note: Mauritius, read on the Economic Development Board's residency portal (residency.mu) on 2026-10-30. This replaces the file held in wave 8 for its fees: the portal's pages say both that the Board charges no fee for processing, successful applicants paying the statutory permit fees prescribed by law to the Government of Mauritius, and that a non-refundable application fee of USD 50 applies to every Occupation Permit application from 1 December 2025, while each permit's table calls its dollar amounts (from 11 July 2022) application fees; which of these is the permit's own fee, and who charges it, isn't clear, so no fee is written. A professional employed by a local or multinational company, at a basic salary of at least MUR 50,000 a month, holds an Occupation Permit for up to 10 years depending on the contract of employment (read as work for the employer, who starts the application online without the professional having to travel to Mauritius; apply read as either), renewable with a renewed contract; its term varies with the contract, so none is written. A self-employed person investing at least USD 50,000 holds a 10-year Occupation Permit, renewable. A 20-year Permanent Residence Permit, renewable for another 20, may be asked after 5 years on an Occupation Permit (a professional earning at least MUR 400,000 a month, a self-employed person with MUR 3 million a year in business income) within 6 months of meeting the criteria (read as applied for in Mauritius). The years naturalisation asks aren't on these pages.

sources.title: Economic Development Board Mauritius, Residency by Profession, Professional
sources.said: Minimum monthly basic salary MUR 50,000 Validity Maximum 10 years, depending upon duration of contract of employment Renewable Renewing criteria A renewed contract of employment with minimum monthly basic salary ... Holds an OP as Professional or a valid work permit for at least 5 years, and has a basic monthly salary of at least MUR 400,000 for 5 consecutive years immediately preceding the application for the PRP. ... Duration Application fee (USD) Short-term OP (not exceeding 9 months) 300 Subsequent extension for short-term OP (not exceeding 3 months) 150 Not more than 2 years 400 More than 2 years but not more than 3 years 500 More than 3 years but not more than 5 years 800 More than 5 years and up to 10 years 1,000 ... Your employer can start the application process online without the need for you to travel to Mauritius. ... In addition, the Economic Development Board does not charge any fees for processing of applications for these permits. Only successful applicants are required to pay the statutory permit fees, as prescribed by law, to the Government of Mauritius. ... Please be informed that an application fee of USD 50 (non-refundable) is effective as from 01 December 2025 for all Occupation Permit and Retired Residence Permit applications.

sources.title: Economic Development Board Mauritius, Self Employed Entrepreneurs
sources.said: Minimum investment USD 50,000 Validity 10 years, renewable Applicable fee USD 1,000 upon approval of application *New fees as from 11 July 2022

sources.title: Economic Development Board Mauritius, Permanent Residence Permit (PRP)
sources.said: It is a 20-year residency, open to investors, retirees, professionals, self-employed entrepreneurs, and their family. ... renewable for another 20 years, provided the residency requirements have been fulfilled. ... Self-Employed: Holds an OP as self-employed for at least 5 years with an annual business income of at least MUR 3 million for the 5 consecutive years, immediately preceding the application for the PRP
